events.content: Reviewed three new PR 3125 comments covering Git end-of-options parsing and two workflow contract assertions.
Added a failing parser regression, then made _positional_args treat every token after a bare -- as positional while preserving option-value consumption.
Changed the Windows contract to require UV_PYTHON 3.14 within the env mapping and to accept absent or explicit false continue-on-error values.
Verification: uv run pytest tests/ -x -q completed with 14363 passed. Focused tests, Ruff, mypy, Python 3.10 syntax, actionlint, security scan, and independent review passed.

The remote branch advanced before push. Stopped on the SHA mismatch, fetched Cursor commits fce488945 and 95e836fc0, reviewed their net change, and merged the valid Trace2 isolation fix without overwriting remote work.
Added contract coverage for removing caller Trace2 variables from guard Git reads and replaced blind workflow YAML casts with explicit root, jobs, job, and steps shape assertions.
